executionLanes.label: Deterministic control/proxy lane
executionLanes.operatorUse: Run-path and shard-integrity proof only. This does not score local or provider model quality.
executionLanes.queryExpansionPolicy: Deterministic fallback only; does not count as large-model query-expansion evidence.
executionLanes.shardIntakeCompatibility: diagnostic subset only; full-shard intake rejects it as strategy-set mismatch

executionLanes.label: Local Apple no-spend lane
executionLanes.operatorUse: Use first when validating the no-spend local method before cloud challenger spend.
executionLanes.queryExpansionPolicy: Local or deterministic query expansion must be reported separately from cloud expansion.
executionLanes.shardIntakeCompatibility: diagnostic subset only; full-shard intake rejects it as strategy-set mismatch

executionLanes.label: Voyage minimum challenger lane
executionLanes.operatorUse: Use when Voyage quota is available to unblock the same-data Voyage answer-quality comparison.
executionLanes.queryExpansionPolicy: No separate query-expansion claim unless a query-expansion arm is included and scored.
executionLanes.shardIntakeCompatibility: diagnostic subset only; full-shard intake rejects it as strategy-set mismatch

executionLanes.label: NVIDIA minimum challenger lane
executionLanes.operatorUse: Use for an NVIDIA challenger comparison without spending Voyage quota.
executionLanes.queryExpansionPolicy: No separate query-expansion claim unless a query-expansion arm is included and scored.
executionLanes.shardIntakeCompatibility: diagnostic subset only; full-shard intake rejects it as strategy-set mismatch

executionLanes.label: Full SOTA shard-intake lane
executionLanes.operatorUse: Only this lane has the complete strategy set expected by shard intake and combine.
executionLanes.queryExpansionPolicy: Query expansion, local rerank, local Apple, and provider challengers must all be present on the same shards.
executionLanes.shardIntakeCompatibility: accepted only after every planned shard returns with this complete strategy set
